mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.iam_audit_log ( tenant_id, operator_type, operator_id, operator_organization_id, action_code, target_type, target_id, reason, result, trace_id, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{operatorType}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorOrganizationId}, #{actionCode}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reason}, #{result}, #{traceId}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, operator_type, operator_id, operator_organization_id, action_code, target_type, target_id, reason, result, trace_id, occurred_time, created_time FROM public.iam_audit_log WHERE ORDER BY occurred_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
